tagline: The agent that argues with itself before it tells you why.
track: Track 02 - The Agent That Can Explain Why

modes.live: Zetaris instance via ZETARIS_REST_URL + model provider
modes.sample: SAMPLE_MODE=true: Zetaris snapshot (read through Zetaris) executed by DuckDB, real agent logic; Nemotron if a key is set, otherwise the deterministic offline reasoner (labelled)

agents.name: Guard
agents.authority: refuses unsafe questions before any agent runs (deny-list fallback without an NVIDIA route)

agents.name: Framer
agents.authority: may stop the run with one clarifying question

agents.name: Hypothesiser
agents.authority: proposes rival hypotheses from the typed cause catalogue

agents.name: Analyst
agents.authority: compiles tests to SQL, runs them on Zetaris, computes statistics, applies the rule table

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.authority: veto: a supported verdict must face an untested confounder test; also challenges the null

agents.name: Writer
agents.authority: writes the explanation card; every claim cites evidence

agents.name: Verifier
agents.authority: veto: re-executes cited SQL and strikes numbers not in the evidence

agents.name: Memory Keeper
agents.authority: recalls and stores owner facts and verdicts (Meterless H-MEM)

zetaris.role: Only live data path: federates the PostgreSQL ledger datasource and 7 Eurostat REST tables through the Unified Semantic Layer 'causeway'; every number traces to a Lightning SQL run that the Verifier re-executes.

engines.name: World Model
engines.role: shared evidence graph for all agents (hypotheses, evidence, verdicts, challenges, claims, owner facts) with provenance

engines.name: H-MEM
engines.role: cross-session owner facts, verdict history, feedback and the append-only trust ledger; recall before the Hypothesiser

engines.name: Markovian
engines.role: bounded multi-round Hypothesiser-Skeptic-Writer dialogue with compressed carryover between rounds

nvidia.access: build.nvidia.com (integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1), hosted; Nebius Token Factory Nemotron as failover; no local GPU

cursor.usage: Development environment: committed .cursor/rules; headless cursor-agent sessions built named components (S1 scaffold, S2 Meterless Runtime provider, S4 web UI), each reviewed and logged

data_sources.name: Eurostat
data_sources.mode: live REST via Zetaris; snapshot in data/snapshot

data_sources.name: Business ledgers
data_sources.note: Synthetic, labelled; ground truth in scripts/businesses.ts and bench/truth is never read by src/

pre_existing: Design documents written 2026-10-15..18 before the window (no product code)
Meterless reference engines @0aa7417 (Apache-2.0, vendored unmodified under vendor/meterless)
Pattern of the Zetaris getting-started Eurostat JSON-stat recipe @44668b2 (Apache-2.0); our SQL is generated in the window
